comments.body:
Thanks for updating the retired default and adding the base64 response handling! The default generation path worked in my offline check, including saving a valid PNG. There is one small parameter compatibility gap I'd like to cover before merging.

`gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` supports `xhigh` and `max` quality, but `GPT_IMAGE_QUALITIES` currently leaves both out. As a result, an explicit request for either quality is silently changed to `auto` in `_prepare_api_request`. The supported values are listed in the [official model documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst).

Could you make the allowed qualities model-aware, preserving `xhigh` and `max` for models that support them, including their dated snapshots, while keeping the compatibility fallback for unsupported values? Please also add regression tests for both options and ensure they are not forwarded to models that do not support them.

My targeted offline checks finished with 24 passing and 2 failing; the two failures were exactly these quality-preservation cases. No live API calls were made. This does not prevent the default `auto` path from working, but it would be good to preserve explicit user choices as part of this migration. Thanks!

Thanks for the careful check. Pushed a follow-up that makes the allowed qualities model-aware: `xhigh` and `max` are preserved for `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` and its dated snapshots, and still fall back to `auto` for models that don't support them. Added regression tests for both values on the supported model and for the not-forwarded case on other models.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
